_comment: zh_CN translation of the solenne_side table, keyed by the English text.

strings.Beat Factor Lusk in his strongroom, then: 在金库里击败代理人Lusk，然后回去找Bex。
strings.Corin Lusk, heir of the Brass Veil, want: 黄铜帷幕的继承人Corin Lusk想买下你的队伍。击败他三次。
strings.Old Mags wants the eight brass seals the: 老Mags想要帷幕钉在Ochrewell各处的八枚黄铜印。她要把它们熔成勺子。
strings.Qadir wants the five worst IOUs of Ochre: Qadir想要Ochrewell最糟的五张欠条来生篝火。
strings.The Brass Veil keeps a cistern under its: 黄铜帷幕在Ochrewell的账房底下有个蓄水池。查清它在数什么。
strings.The Veil keeps its orders in the lowest: 帷幕把命令存放在蓄水池最底层的房间。读一读命令簿。
strings.The Veil prepaid three graves with Under: 帷幕在殡仪师Bex那里预付了三座坟墓。查清是给谁的。
strings.The last valve turns, the cistern drains: 最后一个阀门转动，蓄水池排空，楼梯畅通了！
strings.The pipes gurgle along happily. The stai: 管道欢快地咕噜作响。楼梯保持干燥。
strings.The valve screams, and every pipe slams: 阀门尖叫一声，所有管道又砰地关上了。重新开始。
strings.The valve squeals round. Somewhere, wate: 阀门吱吱地转动。某处的水换了主人。
三块无礼的墓碑，已全额付清。
strings.You know whose graves they are. Tell Bex: 你知道那是谁的坟了。告诉Bex。
